//: Which Google Sheet the roster comes from, so a re-import is one command and nobody has to find the id again. Committed deliberately: a Sheet id is not a secret, because access is granted by sharing the Sheet with the importer's service account, not by keeping the id quiet. Overridden by --sheet=<id> or SHEET_ID.
//range: Omits the tab name on purpose, which reads the first sheet — the registrations tab. Naming a tab that does not exist fails with an unhelpful error, which is how the default used to be wrong.
